name: Zenbook Duo bottom OLED
author: squinto
description: ASUS Zenbook Duo UX8406CA bottom OLED (eDP-2): an on/off toggle (default off) and a screen trackpad carved out of the panel, usable with the panel lit or dark.

barWidget.description: Two buttons: toggle the Zenbook Duo bottom OLED (eDP-2, default off) and toggle the screen trackpad. Enable with --after omarchy.tray to sit in the right cluster after the system tray.
